name: campushub
description: Student campus platform for clubs and events with auth, membership roles, and joins.
author: Harshitha

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c teal,green "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
